name: îles
description: îles is a Vite and Vue powered static site generator built on islands architecture, turning Markdown and Vue pages into static HTML.
notes: firstRelease from npm iles creation (2021-09-09). This setup uses a bare default layout rendering the post title and content, an index page listing every post via import.meta.glob, srcDir set to the project root, and remark-gfm for tables (not enabled by default).
